I will be attending next week’s Conference of Economists in Melbourne and giving a paper on [Japanese Monetary Policy under Quantitative Easing: Neo-Wicksellian versus Monetarist Interpretations](http://gemini.econ.umd.edu/cgi-bin/conference/download.cgi?db_name=ACE2005&paper_id=131 "Japanese Monetary Policy under Quantitative Easing: Neo-Wicksellian versus Monetarist Interpretations") (the full list of conference papers can be found [here](http://gemini.econ.umd.edu/conference/ACE2005/program/ACE2005.html "here")).  My paper is scheduled for the Monetary Policy session kicking-off at 11:15am Monday in the Old Arts Theatre. 

Looking forward to catching-up with IE readers at the conference.
